plugins.name: ux-design-cycle
plugins.description: UX-design record state machine: idle -> drafting -> reviewed. Wakes after a new/changed product-record (or a chain-root hypothesis); the ux-design-record must carry a non-empty pointer to its governing hypothesis/product-record; reaching `loop_state: reviewed` is what wakes coding per contract §3.

plugins.name: ux-design-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs ux-design-cycle via dependency.
